note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs bill-of-lading records (Jan–Feb 2026) with destination, HS code and BOL number: Russia (Kazan, Moscow), France (Lyon), Philippines (Manila), all via Delhi Air Cargo. Note the declared HS codes 853690/853890 do NOT match the actual shipment HS codes observed — 90261090 (instruments for measuring flow/level of liquids) and 90330000 (parts/accessories for instruments of Ch.90). Per project rule 3, HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained with verdict accepted_hs_corrected and actual HS codes recorded as 90261090 / 90330000. Direction of trade is mixed: the company appears both as importer (from Russian suppliers OIL LLC/OOO, FMETER LLC) and as exporter (to Geoloc Conseils France, SSD GPS Corporation Philippines, UAB Monito Lithuania, Flames of Al Yamama Saudi Arabia, TehAvtomatika LLC Russia) — i.e. it is a manufacturer_trader profile with in-house production claimed on its own site ("5000 m2 Production Facility", "1500500 Sensors Produced"). Domestic Indian supply evidence could not be verified due to registry blocks (403) and search outage — recorded as unknown, not as none_found, since the negative could not be established.
